summary: Frontend-only test of the Welcome changes and the Boat Inventory Set Up Wizard, at a 390x844 mobile viewport, signed in as test-welcome-new. 5 of the 6 requested flows passed. The tutorial links failed for 2 of their 3 tutorials. (1) Welcome has no bottom Reset All/export bar (bottom-reset-all-btn count 0). Boat Inventory still shows it. (2) All 3 tutorial links exist. Each one switches to the Model Vessel (mbp_boats_active=model_vessel, body has training-mode) with no confirm dialog. BUG: the first time on a device (a fresh browser), Magic Scanning and Batch Magic Scanning both open the Basic Introduction Walkthrough at step 1 of 6, with an empty title. The second time in the same browser, the right tutorial opens (Batch Magic Scanning, step 1 of 12). (3) welcome-make-home-btn shows the toast 'Home list changed' and opens the wizard while type/make/model/year are empty. Next stays disabled until all 4 are filled and the year has 4 digits (letters are stripped). The values were saved to the DB and show in the VESSEL field and in Additional boat details (type, make, model and year 2014). If the details are already filled in, the wizard does not open. (4) The schematic search returned 10 results for '2014 Beneteau Oceanis 38'. Picking a result, then Use, then crop save opened the 'Magically place colours' panel. The Magic Mariner placed 10 colours by itself in about 15s. Next led to the done panel. Open Boat Inventory showed that schematic with 10 colours placed. (5) Blank path: setup-no-schematic-btn opens the blank panel with the hull and the palette. Next shows 'Drop at least one colour first' and is disabled. Tapping Galley then the plan placed 1 colour and enabled Next. The done panel says 'You're set up using a blank schematic'. Boat Inventory showed the blank overview with Galley. (6) Closing the schematic search dialog (Escape) went back to panel 1 with the typed values kept.

ui_bugs.component: Welcome > Recommended for you tutorial links (BoatPrep.launchTutorial + TrainingMode)
ui_bugs.issue: The first time on a device (no mbp_model_copy:<uid> in localStorage), Magic Scanning and Batch Magic Scanning open the Basic Introduction Walkthrough instead. The header shows 'TRAINING · STEP 1 OF 6' with no title. In a browser that has used the Model Vessel before, the right tutorial opens. A new skipper on the Welcome screen is exactly the first-use case.

issues: Boat Inventory opens with the Zone Map section collapsed (zone-map-toggle aria-expanded=false). The user has to expand it to see the overview the wizard just made. Consider expanding it and scrolling to it.

The blank hull is only about 320x112px, which is a small target for dropping colours. The 'Magically Place Colours' button is also shown on the blank hull, where AI placement has nothing to work from. Consider hiding it on the blank panel.

action_items: Fix the first-use tutorial bug. RCA: launchTutorial calls restartWalkthrough(uid, w.key), which sets mbp_model_wizard=<key> and mbp_model_fresh=false, and then calls boats.select(modelBoat). TrainingMode then mounts for the first time. Its init `useState(() => { if (copy && read(k.copy,'') !== copy) { reset(k); ... } })` runs reset(k) with which undefined. That sets mbp_model_fresh=true, so the starting wizard (Basic Introduction) is shown instead of the one chosen. Observed localStorage after the first click: mbp_model_wizard='"magic scanning"', mbp_model_fresh='true'. Possible fix: in that copy-reset, keep the chosen walkthrough when a launch is pending (for example a sessionStorage flag set by restartWalkthrough), or have launchTutorial write mbp_model_copy before switching. The same path probably affects Help > Model Vessel > walkthrough (startWalkthrough/switchToModel) on a fresh device.
critical_code_review_comments: InventorySetupWizard.next calls onField once for each changed field (up to 5 changeBoatField calls in a row). This worked in testing, but each call may sync on its own. A single batched patch would be safer.
In the wizard, the boat type select reuses BoatTypeField, which has id='boat-type'. If AdditionalDetailsDialog were ever open at the same time there would be 2 elements with that id. Harmless now.
useBlank fetches /blank-hull.png relative to the page. That is fine at the root path but would break if the app were served from a sub-path.

success_rate.frontend: 92% (tutorial links fail for 2 of 3 on first use in a fresh browser; all wizard flows pass)

seed_data_creation: None kept. Both zone_maps the tests created were deleted through DELETE /api/boats/main/zone-maps/{id}. test-welcome-new main boat: vessel, boat_type, make, model and year_built unset, zone_maps empty, home_list='welcome'. Welcome answers were set as requested (mv_ack true, find yes).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use a fresh browser.new_context() for each run: Welcome opens on its own while it is unfinished. list-selector is a Radix Select: click it, then click [data-testid=list-option-<id>]. The walkthrough window is [data-training-window]. To reproduce the tutorial bug you need a fresh context (no mbp_model_copy in localStorage). The Zone map section in Boat Inventory starts collapsed: click zone-map-toggle. Magic placement took about 15s. Reset helper: unset boat.vessel/boat_type/make/model/year_built, set zone_maps=[] and boat.home_list='welcome' on user_boats {owner_id:'test-welcome-new', boat_id:'main'}.
